basic_info.description: Incredible opportunity on prime Inner Richmond block. Rare Edwardian with preserved workmanship and period detail has been in the same family for over 75 years! Four sunny bedrooms, including a spacious primary that overlooks the charming yard, are upstairs. Formal dining room with original built-in cabinetry, delightful sun porch. In-law studio apartment with full kitchen and its own separate entrance is on the lower level. Ideally located on quiet block within easy walking distance of Golden Gate Park (De Young Museum, Japanese Tea Garden, Academy of Science) and the vibrant restaurants and shops of Geary & Clement. Walk score 88, Bike score 97, Transit score 72.
